branch.ACTIVE_PROTECTED: Branch is protected and not default
branch.STALE_NO_PR: Branch has no open PR and last commit > 30 days ago
branch.RECENT_NO_PR: Branch has no open PR but last commit < 30 days ago
branch.ORPHANED: Branch author inactive or pattern suggests abandonment

pr.ACTIVE_IN_PROGRESS: PR has state:in-progress label or recent activity < 7 days
pr.ACTIVE_REVIEW: PR has state:review or state:approved label
pr.READY_TO_MERGE: PR approved and no blocking labels

issue.ACTIVE_ASSIGNED: Issue is assigned and updated < 14 days
issue.STALE_ASSIGNED: Issue is assigned but no activity > 14 days
issue.STALE_UNASSIGNED: Issue unassigned and no activity > 14 days
issue.TRACKING_ISSUE: Issue used for phase tracking (label pattern)

tag.ORPHANED_TAG: Tag points to commit not in main branch history
